summary: Fixture run on synthetic reviews. Customers like the product and the price; the problems are what happens after they pay: late deliveries and refunds that do not arrive.

delivery.problem: Orders arrive weeks late and tracking does not update
delivery.root_cause: Possibly one courier or one warehouse; the reviews do not say which.
delivery.fix: Pull late-order data by courier and region, and send proactive delay emails.
delivery.geo_action: Reply to each late-delivery review with the current delivery window; publish real delivery times on the shipping page.

refunds.problem: Refunds take more than six weeks or never arrive
refunds.root_cause: Refunds may wait for a manual approval step.
refunds.fix: Set a 10 business day refund promise and track it.
refunds.geo_action: Put the refund timeline in the returns FAQ and link it in replies.
